title: Collision Findings
description: IDEATE-stage artifact (novelty-collision-upgrade; see _design/novelty-collision-upgrade-LEDGER.md). The independent novelty-collision-checker worker's per-idea prior-art findings: it decomposes each idea into method×application×domain, emits targeted queries, runs real retrieval, and judges each near-hit. SEMANTIC-JUDGMENT-ONLY: this bundle records what the worker found and claims; it NEVER decides a cut. The deterministic gate (tools/novelty_collision.build_collision_verdict) decides — and a collision CUTS only on an existence-verified paper (citation_existence must pass), never on a vaguely-similar or unconfirmable one. A worker 'collision' whose papers fail existence becomes UNVERIFIED, never DEAD.

memo_contract_version.description: Current split-panel investment-memo contract. Optional solely for hash-bound legacy replay compatibility; current panel loaders require it.

findings.description: One entry per candidate. A missing idea finding is UNVERIFIED, never implicit clearance.

method_combination.description: The decomposed method / technique combination under test (e.g. 'Tversky + boundary loss on a frozen foundation model').

application.description: The application / problem the idea targets (the 'on what' — e.g. 'inferior-alveolar-canal segmentation').

domain.description: The research domain / field the idea sits in (e.g. 'dental CBCT', 'NLP').

queries.description: The targeted retrieval queries the worker issued to hunt for prior art.

verdict.description: collision = a full-paper exact claim collision; adjacent = reviewed partial/base/gap work; clear = adequate targeted retrieval found no collision within coverage; unverified = retrieval or full-text evidence is insufficient for clearance or collision.

colliding_papers.description: The specific colliding papers (MUST be [] when verdict is 'clear'). Each must name a resolvable ref so the gate can existence-verify it; an unverifiable ref can never justify a cut.

ref.description: A resolvable citation: 'arXiv:2407.01517' | 'doi:10.xxxx/...' | a near-exact title. The gate runs citation_existence on this exact string.

does_same_method_on_same_problem.description: True only if this paper applies the SAME method combination to the SAME problem (not merely related). A DEAD cut requires True.

experimentally_validated.description: True if the paper actually RAN / implemented it (not merely proposed). When the gate's cut_requires_experiments is on, a DEAD cut requires True.

full_text_reviewed.description: True only after the full method and decision-relevant experiments were inspected. Title, abstract, or snippet review is false and can never justify a cut.

fulltext_snapshot_ref.description: Run-local full-text snapshot actually read. Required for exact_collision so a destructive cut is inspectable.

fulltext_snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the run-local full-text snapshot. The deterministic gate recomputes it before any cut.

relationship.description: Claim-level relationship after reading the paper. Only exact_collision can justify a cut.

same_central_claim.description: Whether the paper tests the same central scientific claim rather than merely sharing a keyword or component.

same_input_output_contract.description: Whether the relevant input state, interaction, output/edit semantics, and target contract are materially equivalent.

same_causal_evaluation.description: Whether the paper runs a materially equivalent causal assay capable of establishing the same claimed mechanism.

evidence_loci.description: All page, section, table, or figure locators actually inspected.

method_evidence_loci.description: At least one full-text locator establishing the implemented method and input/output contract.

result_evidence_loci.description: At least one experiment, result, table, figure, or ablation locator establishing what was actually evaluated.

material_surviving_delta.description: True when a meaningful and falsifiable method, mechanism, data, control, or evaluation delta remains. Any true value forbids an exact-collision cut.

surviving_gap.description: What the paper does not establish and what a gap-based extension could still test.

justification.description: Why this paper collides — the worker's reasoning.

quote.description: An optional verbatim snippet from the paper supporting the collision claim.

closest_prior_art.description: Verified closest work even when it is only adjacent. This separates a scoped remaining delta from an unsupported novelty claim.

difference_from_prior_art.description: The precise method, mechanism, evaluation, data, or control-regime delta that remains after scoped retrieval.

visual_evidence.description: Figure/table evidence only when actually inspected; an empty list is the honest default.

confidence.description: The worker's confidence in this finding (advisory; does not by itself decide the cut).

retrieval_status.description: Whether targeted retrieval produced enough inspectable material. partial still requires verdict=unverified when decisive full text is missing; unavailable can never be clearance.

retrieval_note.description: Coverage / retrieval caveats (e.g. 'one source was unreachable; coverage partial').

evidence_ref.description: Pointer(s) to the worker's collision bundle (e.g. ['inbox/COLLISION.bundle.json']).
